name: Boon of Combat Prowess
summary: +1 to any ability (max 30); once per round, turn a missed attack roll into a hit.

benefits.name: Peerless Aim
benefits.summary: Turn a missed attack roll into a hit; usable again at the start of your next turn.
benefits.text: When you miss with an attack roll, you can hit instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until the start of your next turn.
